ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Calculate the approximate output voltage of this regulated power supply circuit under no-load conditions, as shown in the figure. The approximate output voltage is ______ V.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a rectified regulated power supply: on the left are a 120 VAC input and transformer, in the middle are bridge rectification and a 1000 μF filter capacitor; on the right is the regulation stage, where the rectified and filtered voltage is sent through a 1 kΩ resistor to the transistor base node, this node has a Zener diode labeled 6.9 V connected to ground, the output terminal +V is taken from the emitter of the transistor, and the output terminal also has a 47 μF capacitor to ground. Reasoning: Under the approximate no-load condition, the Zener diode clamps the transistor base voltage at about 6.9 V. This transistor acts as an emitter follower, and the emitter output voltage is about one base-emitter voltage drop lower than the base, taking VBE≈0.7 V. Therefore Vout≈Vz−VBE=6.9−0.7=6.2 V.

raw_record.question_text: Calculate the approximate output voltage of this regulated power supply circuit under no-load conditions, as shown in the figure. The approximate output voltage is ______ V.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the rightmost regulation stage, noting the 6.9 V zener connected from the transistor base node to ground through the 1 kΩ feed resistor, and the output taken from the transistor emitter. From the text, use the requested no-load approximate output voltage. Apply the emitter-follower regulator rule Vout ≈ Vz − VBE; with Vz = 6.9 V and VBE ≈ 0.7 V, compute Vout ≈ 6.2 V.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图显示一个整流稳压电源：左侧为120 VAC输入和变压器，中间为桥式整流及1000 μF滤波电容；右侧是稳压级，整流滤波后的电压经1 kΩ电阻送到晶体管基极节点，该节点有一个标注为6.9 V的齐纳二极管接到地，输出端+V从晶体管的发射极取出，输出端还有47 μF电容到地。推理：无负载近似情况下，齐纳二极管把晶体管基极电压钳位在约6.9 V。该晶体管作为发射极跟随器，发射极输出电压约比基极低一个基极-发射极压降，取VBE≈0.7 V。因此Vout≈Vz−VBE=6.9−0.7=6.2 V。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer gives 6.2 V, which matches the standard answer of 6.2 volts exactly.

answer_match_part_results.reason: The numeric value is identical; the predicted answer simply includes the unit.

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct regulator-identification route: it treats the right-hand zener-plus-transistor section as an emitter-follower regulator and uses the no-load approximation rather than analyzing transformer ripple in detail.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the circuit diagram: after the transformer, bridge rectifier, and 1000 µF filter capacitor, a 1 kΩ resistor feeds a node clamped by a zener diode labeled 6.9 V to ground. That same node drives the base of a series pass transistor whose emitter is the +V output, with ground as the lower rail and a 47 µF output capacitor.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question statement to know the required quantity is the approximate no-load output voltage, not loaded voltage, ripple, or transformer secondary voltage.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: For a zener-referenced emitter follower regulator, under no-load conditions the base is held approximately at the zener voltage, and the output at the emitter is approximately one base-emitter junction drop lower: Vout ≈ VZ − VBE. Use VBE ≈ 0.7 V for a silicon transistor, so Vout ≈ 6.9 − 0.7 = 6.2 V, assuming the rectified input is high enough to keep the zener and transistor biased.
